[[File:2025 World Championship group photograph.jpg|thumb|right|420px|Attendees' group photograph; names on the [[:File:2025 World Championship group photograph.jpg|file page]].]]
The '''2025 World Championship''' was the 30th Star Wars CCG World Championship, held by the [[Players Committee]] at the Hampton Inn & Suites in SeaTac, Washington, over the weekend of 3–5 October 2025, with four sanctioned events across three days; the main event was played on 4–5 October.<ref name="wrap" /><ref name="pc" /> The main event had 55 players.<ref name="wrap" /> Hall of Famer [[Greg Shaw]] defeated [[Joe Olson]] in the Final Confrontation with Shadow Collective and The Force Is Strong In My Family (Luke Saga),<ref name="wrap" /><ref name="pc" /> winning his first World Championship after finishing runner-up in 2002 and 2003.<ref name="wrap" /> [[Brian Fred]] was inducted into the Players Committee Hall of Fame on Saturday morning.<ref name="wrap" />

=== Top 8 bracket ===

Day 1 was eight games of Swiss play with a cut to the Top 8.<ref name="wrap" />
* '''Quarterfinals:''' [[Greg Shaw|Shaw]] def. [[Patrick Johnson|Pat Johnson]]; [[Brian Fred]] def. [[Benji Chu]]; [[Joe Olson|Olson]] def. [[Matthew Harrison-Trainor]]; [[Hayes Hunter]] def. [[Sam Tashima]].<ref name="wrap" />
* '''Semifinals:''' [[Greg Shaw|Shaw]] def. [[Brian Fred|Fred]]; [[Joe Olson|Olson]] def. [[Hayes Hunter|Hunter]].<ref name="wrap" />
* '''Final:''' [[Greg Shaw|Shaw]] def. [[Joe Olson|Olson]].<ref name="wrap" />

Game scores were not published. The games were streamed with commentary by [[Dan Tartaglione]] and [[Garrett Larson]] and posted to a [https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLQSFYZX0M9YQ_9BL8VcsfvHD371AW5aWM YouTube playlist] (Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261123220003/https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLQSFYZX0M9YQ_9BL8VcsfvHD371AW5aWM Internet Archive]).<ref name="wrap" />

== Side events ==

* '''Team tournament''' (Friday evening, 11 teams, glass mug trophies): won by team "Scott Norwood", [[Brian Fred]] and [[Jonny Chu]]; [[Mike Turner]] and [[Nathan Davis|Nate Davis]] were second.<ref name="wrap" />
* '''Cube''' (Friday, 18 players): won by [[Steve Harpster]]; [[Anthony Howard]] was second.<ref name="wrap" />
* '''Consolation''' (Sunday, 36 players): won at 6–0 by [[Bryan Mischke]] (spelled "[[Bryan Mischke|Brian Mischke]]" in the wrap-up); [[Jonny Chu]] was second.<ref name="wrap" /> The full sheet lists places 1–36.<ref name="consolsheet">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=86012 2025 Worlds Consolation Pairings], forum.starwarsccg.org (6 October 2025). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261123222114/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t86012.html Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''Hall of Fame:''' [[Brian Fred]], inducted on Saturday morning, presented by his New Allies teammate [[Mike Kessling]].<ref name="wrap" />
* '''Board game''' (Sunday morning): players played a board game as a side event at the main tournament.<ref name="bisco20261124">Personal communication from [[Bill Bisco]], 24 November 2026.</ref>
